book.name: Ioane
book.title: Ioane Iesu Keriso Hari Manoḡa Ioaneꞌa Mirihiro

content: Vu hina Vaini Vuḡa Haḡairo
Mada uḡiduḡano Galilea habaꞌano Kana neḡano hahu muiḡa ꞌahoga haḡairo, ebu Iesu viꞌaꞌe mui eꞌe zamaḡano radiro.
Mui vazeḡaniꞌa Iesu zu ane tahiꞌatahiꞌa zuni huziro.
Muio vaini vuḡaniꞌa hauḡirotene, viꞌaniꞌa Iesu niro, “Ze vaini vuḡaꞌe hauḡeha.”
Iesuꞌa naenaeniro, “Roḡae boro, ḡa nougadu eḡe mazao ꞌouge raꞌohe? Eḡe gau madaḡaꞌe ꞌize mene maha.”
Rehano viꞌaniꞌa mui tuḡure azaḡa ziro, “Aniꞌa nouge rae zoꞌidene, ꞌouge haḡaoꞌi.”
Ebu hadi hina haḡairoteꞌe vu ḡoḡoreḡa fuꞌo tiba fareꞌe deꞌea. Aꞌe Iuda azaḡa goro idunaḡano, ze zu ḡauze dehenoga veize tiro.
Hadi vu ḡoḡoreḡa tibatibano vu 20 gareni onamo 30 gareni iriꞌavonoga idararo.
Iesuꞌa tuḡure azaḡa ziro, “Ḡoḡore niduꞌa vu iriꞌavonoꞌi.” ꞌOugadu ze vu beuꞌe ite hebeꞌano iri'avoniro.
Ebu Iesuꞌa ziro, “Vu nu iḡi vaḡinadu mui ibitohauꞌeteꞌe vazeḡa ha onamoꞌi.” Eꞌanoꞌo ze ꞌouge haḡairo.

Ebu mui ibitohauꞌeteꞌe vazeḡaniꞌa vu eꞌe vaini vuḡano reiroteꞌe gage nuriro. Aniꞌe vaini vuḡa eꞌe noumanoꞌo mae arirotaꞌaꞌe aḡuꞌa, u vu iḡi vaḡiniroteꞌe tuḡure azaḡaꞌe edeḡa. Ebu mui ibitohauꞌeteꞌe vazeḡaniꞌa hahu iziga ohozeḡa huniro.

Ebu ani matuꞌeꞌenaꞌa, hahu iziga ohozeḡa niro, “Vaze niduꞌa vaini vuḡa manoḡa tauḡi ibite oma mae fureneꞌohe. Ebu mui azaḡaniꞌa gage sautuꞌetuꞌu hena tahiḡa manoḡa mae fureneꞌohe. Rehano ḡaeꞌa onao izidi vaini vuḡa manoḡa tauḡi vazevaze veize modeha.”
Iesuꞌa haḡai nu badeḡa ibiꞌaꞌe Galilea habaꞌano Kana neḡano ꞌahige haḡairo. ꞌOugadu ani ane ni mae ḡihiniro, ebu ane tahiꞌatahiꞌaꞌa ani mazao firo.
Mui ḡarugano Iesuꞌe viꞌa, negoḡa duḡuru zu ane tahiꞌatahiꞌa teite Kaperanauma ovoiro. Ebu eꞌea mada nu radiro.
Kuru Neḡa Deheniro
Iuda azaḡa Iḡine Modiroteꞌe Muiḡa madaḡaniꞌa hanitirotene, Iesuꞌe Ierusalema itiro.
Ebu ani vaze nuꞌe kuru neḡa habaꞌano boromakau, mamoe zu Tubugo niniḡa seronoga horoziro, ebu nuꞌe fataze babaḡano ehoradu hadi seniso zenoga
horoziro.

ꞌOugadu ani mini hina masizeꞌeteꞌe ḡauḡa haḡadu eꞌe hina zeḡe niduꞌa ebu mamoe zu boromakau niduꞌa kuru neḡa habaꞌanonoꞌo masize ḡururuziro. Ebu hadi seniso ziniꞌeteꞌe azaḡa hadize beuꞌe ḡuzuhiro, zu fataze mae ḡihuniro.
Ebu Tubugo niniḡa seroneꞌeteꞌe azaḡa ziro, “Ḡau ꞌahi niduꞌa ꞌadanoꞌo mae vaḡinoꞌi! Mamahe neꞌe maketi habaꞌano ago haḡaoꞌi!”
Ane tahiꞌatahiꞌaꞌe Buka Zaḡoḡano ḡoere ꞌahi zamariro, “E Badiꞌa ne zamare borofeꞌohe.”
Ebu Iuda azaḡaniꞌa ḡadiniro, “Ḡa nagi gigiꞌaḡa hina ꞌahiguḡa haḡaeꞌohe? Ḡae gigiꞌaꞌe Badiꞌa mazaonoꞌo roꞌidene, haḡai nu badeḡa ihofoꞌi.”
Ebu Iesuꞌa naenaeziro, “Kuru neḡa ꞌadi fahoꞌi, ꞌougine eḡeꞌa mada uḡidu zamaḡano bare ohoniꞌuma.”
Zeḡeꞌa niro, “Kuru neḡa ꞌadi ogorarotene muri 46 madu hauḡiro. U ḡaꞌe mada uḡidu zamaḡano ohoniꞌuma rae raꞌehe?”
Rehano Iesuꞌa kuru neḡa reirotaꞌaꞌe ane ahiri moneo reiro.
Iesuꞌe runeonoꞌo bare iḡuniroteꞌe ḡarugano, ane tahiꞌatahiꞌaꞌa ani ḡoere zamariro. Ebu ze Buka Zaḡoḡano mirihiroteꞌe ḡoeꞌa ebu Iesuꞌa reiroteꞌe ḡoeꞌa mae ḡihiniro.
Iesuꞌe Iḡine Modiroteꞌe Muiḡa madaḡano Ierusalemao radiunu. Ebu vaze ḡehaḡaniꞌa aneꞌa haḡai nu badeḡa haḡairoteꞌe horonadu ani mazao firo.
Rehano aniꞌe ze mene mae ḡihiziro, mazaḡa vaze niduꞌa zamaze ederiro.
Vaze zamao naginiꞌa radiuꞌetaꞌaꞌe zuni Iesuꞌa ederiroteꞌe uꞌano, aniꞌe vaze ꞌahoganiꞌa vaze ꞌahoga moneo ani ihonoga mene uratiro.

footnotes.text: Aꞌe Badiꞌa mazao kuranoga veize ga ogomu anoga veize tiro.
